content.text: We provide you the best service!

Our hospital was inaugurated in the presence of H.E Dr Mulatu Teshome President of Ethiopia, mayor of Addis Ababa and some higher officials from Ministry of Health, and became fully operational on the 7th of May 2017 with a sole purpose of providing excellent and standard medical services. Hallelujah Hospital has brought vast knowledge & experiences with dedication and commitment, applying the State-of-the-Art technology to the Hospital Industry. Our hospital is determined to bring new Technologies and render medical services to the Public at a fair and affordable cost.

Hallelujah Hospital provides a comprehensive service at one place, from diagnosis to major surgeries. The hospital has 115 beds, out of which 96 beds are for Inpatients. Our inpatient and outpatient services are supervised by a duly licensed physicians and 24 hours emergency service.

In addition to this, Hallelujah General hospital is located ten minutes away from Bole International Air Port, which makes it convenient for international patients. In the past few years the number of customers/patients in need of our medical service has increased substantially. It has also become a pride for the medical Industry by introducing latest medical services such as full pulmonary function test, sleep laboratory, etc. It currently gives a job opportunity for over 450 people.

To be customer’s first choice, provide high quality and specialized medical care through specialized diagnostic, treatment services, and trusted care at competitive cost and best service enriched by research and training, thereby complementing the preventive medical services rendered by the Government of Ethiopia.

Our hospital aspires to be a well-organized, technologically advanced, and the leading healthcare provider in the horn Africa. We are dedicated to provide quality medical services. We are very meticulous to the details of medical standards, hospitality and compassion to the satisfaction of our clients.

At Hallelujah General Hospital, we believe that communication is one of life’s most powerful tools. Our Speech Therapy Department is dedicated to helping patients of all ages overcome challenges with speech, language, voice, fluency, and swallowing. Whether the difficulty arises from developmental delays, medical conditions, or injury, our specialized therapists provide compassionate, evidence-based care tailored to each individual’s needs.

At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Rheumatology Department specializes in diagnosing, treating, and managing disorders of the joints, muscles, bones, and immune system. Rheumatic diseases can be complex and long-term, often affecting quality of life. Our experienced rheumatologists are dedicated to providing compassionate, comprehensive care that helps patients manage symptoms, maintain mobility, and live healthier lives.

At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Gynecology Department is dedicated to women’s health at every stage of life. From adolescence to menopause and beyond, we provide compassionate, comprehensive care tailored to the unique needs of women. Our team of experienced gynecologists combines advanced medical expertise with a patient-centered approach to ensure comfort, dignity, and well-being.

At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Surgical Department is dedicated to providing expert surgical care with a focus on safety, precision, and optimal recovery. We offer a full range of surgical services, from minimally invasive procedures to complex surgeries, all supported by the latest technology including laparoscopic procedures and a team of experienced surgeons.
Pre-Surgical Assessments: Comprehensive evaluations to ensure that patients are in the best possible health before undergoing surgery, including necessary lab tests and imaging.
Minimally Invasive Surgery(laparoscopic) : Utilizing laparoscopic for faster recovery, less pain, and smaller incisions. This includes procedures for gallbladder removal, hernia repair, and more.
Post-Surgical Care: After your surgery, our expert care team provides dedicated support to ensure a smooth recovery, with personalized instructions for wound care, medication, and physical therapy.
Emergency Surgery: 24/7 availability for emergency surgeries, including trauma surgery, appendectomy, and other urgent procedures.
Pain Management: Advanced pain management techniques to ensure a comfortable post-operative recovery, using a combination of medication, nerve blocks, and alternative therapies when necessary.
Surgical Oncology: Surgical treatments for cancer, including tumor excision, lymph node dissection, and other cancer-related surgeries, with a focus on improving survival rates and quality of life.
Surgical Consultations: Whether you need an initial evaluation for surgery or a second opinion, our surgeons are available to discuss your case in detail and provide clear, thorough recommendations.

At Hallelujah General Hospital our Pediatrics Department is dedicated to providing expert care for neonatal, infants, children, and adolescents. We understand that children have unique healthcare needs, and our compassionate, child-friendly approach ensures that both patients and their families feel supported throughout their healthcare journey.
Well-Child Check-UpsRegular pediatric exams to monitor growth, development, and overall health
Immunizations and Vaccinations
Acute Care for Illnesses and InjuriesImmediate care for common childhood illnesses like colds, ear infections, flu, and more. We also provide treatment for injuries and accidents.

Chronic Disease ManagementOngoing care and support for chronic conditions like asthma, diabetes, epilepsy, and obesity. Our team helps manage treatment plans and works with families to ensure effective care at home.
Nutritional CounselingOffering guidance on healthy eating habits for children, as well as support for children with specific dietary needs or challenges (e.g., food allergies, obesity).
Emergency Pediatric CareImmediate care for children who require urgent attention, including trauma, allergic reactions, and other critical conditions.
Developmental and Behavioral AssessmentsComprehensive evaluations to assess developmental milestones, speech delays, or behavioral concerns, ensuring children are meeting age-appropriate milestones.
